mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE MoM > 0.5% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real estate activity (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM > 1% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales (RSAFS) combined with a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines and UNRATE rises, but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a positive supply-side shock with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises and FEDFUNDS falls, but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
